nonBlockingImprovements.title: Bound bulk confirmation stdin reads
nonBlockingImprovements.issue: promptBulkUpdate reads all of fd 0 with fs.readFileSync(0, "utf8") before parsing the answer, so a non-terminating pipe such as yes can hang or consume unbounded input before the confirmation is evaluated.
nonBlockingImprovements.suggestion: Replace promptBulkUpdate's read with a bounded first-line read, stopping at newline or a small maximum byte count, then pass that line to bulkUpdateAccepted.
nonBlockingImprovements.rationale: The accepted input semantics stay the same, but the confirmation prompt no longer depends on EOF and avoids unbounded stdin consumption.
